name: 战略（分析/定位/实施）框架

map.按 1–10 分对「行业吸引力」（市场增速、市场规模、利润率，越高越好）与「业务: Score "industry attractiveness" (market growth, market size, profit margin - higher is better) and "business competitiveness" (share, brand, technology, channel) on a 1-10 scale, with competitive intensity scored in reverse. Normalize each dimension to 0-100%, place the result in the corresponding cell of the GE nine-box matrix, and give action advice such as invest / select / harvest / divest along with an implementation checklist.
map.把近 12 个月营收按月贴入，看均值、: Paste the last 12 months of revenue by month to see the mean,
map.与极差，判断增长是稳步抬升还是靠单月冲高。: and the range, judging whether growth climbs steadily or relies on a single strong month.
map.战略研讨会前汇总各业务线关键指标（客单价、复购率），用离散程度看哪条线最难预测。: Before a strategy workshop, gather key metrics for each business line (average order value, repurchase rate) and use dispersion to see which line is hardest to forecast.
map.对标同行公开数据时，用同一口径的均值与: When benchmarking against peers' public data, use the mean with the same definition and
map.做横向比较，避免只看峰值造成定位偏差。: for a like-for-like comparison, avoiding positioning bias from looking only at peaks.
map.围绕战略议题提供结构化分析框架（SWOT/竞争定位/实施路径），把模糊讨论拆成可: Provides a structured analysis framework for strategic topics (SWOT / competitive positioning / implementation path), breaking vague discussion into actionable dimensions.
map.行业吸引力 = (市场增长 + 市场规模 + 利润空间 + (11 − 竞争强度: Industry attractiveness = (market growth + market size + profit margin + (11 − competitive intensity)) ÷ 40 × 100%; business competitiveness = sum of the four scores ÷ 40 × 100%; locate the strategic unit in the 3×3 matrix.
map.行业吸引力 = (市场增长 + 市场规模 + 利润空间 + (10 − 竞争强度: Industry attractiveness = (market growth + market size + profit margin + (10 − competitive intensity)) ÷ 40 × 100%; business competitiveness = sum of four scores ÷ 40 × 100%; position the strategic unit on the 3×3 matrix (inputs clamped to 0–10)
map.按 0–10 分对「行业吸引力」（市场增速、市场规模、利润率，越高越好）与「业务: Score industry attractiveness (market growth, market size, profit margin; higher is better) and business competitiveness (share, brand, technology, channel) on a 0-10 scale, where 0 is a valid lowest score. Enter competitive intensity so that a larger value means fiercer competition; the page reverses it as 10−intensity. Normalize both dimensions to 0-100%, place the result in the GE nine-box matrix, and give invest / select / harvest / divest advice with an implementation checklist.
map.行业吸引力维度（各 0–10 分，0 合法；竞争强度数值越大表示越激烈）: Industry attractiveness dimensions (0-10 each, 0 valid; a higher competitive-intensity value means fiercer competition)
map.市场增速 7、规模 8、利润率 6、竞争强度 5 → 吸引力=(7+8+6+5): Growth 7, size 8, margin 6 and competitive intensity 5 → attractiveness=(7+8+6+5)=26/40=65% (medium); share 6, brand 7, technology 6 and channel 5=24/40=60% (medium) → mid-mid, watch and wait.
map.若品牌 7→9、技术 6→8，竞争力=6+9+8+5=28/40=70%，仍为中: If brand rises 7→9 and technology 6→8, competitiveness=6+9+8+5=28/40=70%, still medium; it takes at least 30/40=75% to enter "strong", so fixing weaknesses must cross the threshold rather than shift bands after a small gain.
map.0–10 分中数值越大表示竞争越激烈；行业吸引力使用 10−强度，避免“竞争越激: On a 0-10 scale, a larger value means fiercer competition; attractiveness uses 10−intensity so fiercer competition never adds points.
map.0 是合法最低分，表示该项极低或没有；只有留空或非数字才提示。百分比仍按满分 4: 0 is a valid lowest score meaning very low or absent; only blank or non-numeric input is rejected. Percentages still use a maximum of 40.
map.归一后 ≥75% 为高/强，50–74% 为中，<50% 为低/弱；这是本页固定: After normalization, ≥75% is high/strong, 50-74% medium and <50% low/weak; this is the page fixed rule, not an industry standard.
